title: waiting page: an answered card shrinks, and rail chips and option pictures fit at every width
why: Defect, Oct 28 13:19 CDT (shiv, screenshot of item 47 after his answer): an answered card, filing pending, shows as a huge empty green box; the left overview's chip lists run past the rail and show as clipped rows over the page edge. Second report 13:17 CDT (two screenshots, zoomed out against normal zoom): at a wide viewport the rail's chips overlap the cards, and an option's phone mockup covers its card's text.
note: Slug receipt-keeps-height-forever (orchestrator, Oct 28). Cause of part 1, read in skills/waiting-page/page.html lines 754-759, patch(): a card that turns into a receipt gets minHeight set to the full unanswered card height and keeps it until reload. Next cloud lane, claude-settings only. Part 1: the receipt holds the old height only while in view; once it leaves the viewport (IntersectionObserver) drop the min-height and compensate scroll so nothing in view moves; red first, a page test that answers a card, scrolls it out of view, and asserts it shrinks to its content with no shift on screen. Part 2: at wide viewports the rail's related-item frames (dashed .pairchips groups, full-title chips) grow past the 240px rail and overlap the cards; chips and frame size to the rail, never to their text (ellipsis), at every width. Part 3: at a wide viewport an option's picture (.opts.pics) overflows its card and covers the text above; a picture fits inside its card at every width. Red tests for parts 2 and 3 at 2200px (the zoomed-out case) and 1280; the design reviewer gives a verdict per width. Part 4: a containment sweep test over widths 320 to 2560, both themes and every item state, so no element leaves its card or the rail; it holds the layout for every later lane (shiv, Oct 28 13:19 CDT: a page built well needs no design pass per defect). Same files as c186, c135, c136; lands ahead of them. Port: yes. Needs no answer. Placed after c139 (triage 12, Oct 28, orchestrator).
